rationale: B is clearer and more idiomatic: combinations directly expresses choosing distinct titles, zero counts are removed from the canonical state, and the recursion is concise without fixed-width padding or bit-mask manipulation. A is well documented, but its mask logic is harder to read and its comment that a negative count means a repeated title is inaccurate; it actually means an absent title was selected. B also generalizes more naturally to baskets with an unexpected number of distinct titles while retaining the five-book group limit.
